fix:
<reasoning>
The compile error is purely in the host-side launcher: `gelu_tanh_cute_kernel<<<grid, block, 0, stream>>>(...)` references `grid` and `block`, but only `grid_x` (an `unsigned`) was computed, and `block` was never declared (nvcc resolves it to a CUTE function named `block`, causing the "bool (int) to dim3" error). The minimal fix that preserves the CUTE kernel and its launch structure is to declare `dim3 grid(grid_x);` and `dim3 block(256);` right after obtaining the stream (line 93) and before the kernel launch (line 94). The block size 256 matches `constexpr int Threads = 256` in the kernel and the `(vec_total + 255) / 256` tile computation on the host. No kernel logic or intent is changed.
</reasoning>
